page_title: AST 1-2 MNU | Aston Villa v Manchester Utd 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Robert Jones is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' A neat pass is well received by Matty Cash (Aston Villa), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
90+2' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a change. Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) replaces Kobbie Mainoo.
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Rasmus Hojlund is given a rest as he is replaced by Jonny Evans (Manchester United).
90+1' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
87' John McGinn goes off the pitch and Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) comes on.
87' Substitution. Alex Moreno did his best and is replaced by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
86' 1 - 2 Goal! Scott McTominay (Manchester United) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Diogo Dalot and easily beat the keeper with a header into the middle of the goal from close range. 1:2.

82' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Emiliano Martinez is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
79' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) dribbles into the box, but Andre Onana is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
77' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out.

76' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
73' Erik ten Hag prepares a substitution. Marcus Rashford is replaced by Scott McTominay (Manchester United).
73' That's the end of the game for Leon Bailey, who is replaced by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
72' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
71' Today's referee Robert Jones rightly decides to book Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) for his harsh tackle.
71' Good team movement sets up Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
67' 1 - 1 Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball into the top right corner.

67' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Andre Onana with a fabulous save.
67' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) prepares to take a corner kick.
66' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

66' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.
65' Unai Emery is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) suffers an injury and Moussa Diaby comes on.
65' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
61' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
60' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sees a yellow card from Robert Jones after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
59' The resulting corner from Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is cleared.

59' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Corner kick. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity.
58' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
57' John McGinn (Aston Villa) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
56' A corner kick by Aston Villa is thwarted by the well prepared Andre Onana (Manchester United).
55' John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner.
51' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

51' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
50' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) heads on.
49' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' Great chance! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.

47' What an amazing save by Emiliano Martinez! Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Erik ten Hag gives a chance to Victor Lindelof and Luke Shaw (Manchester United) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Robert Jones has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester Utd are going to take it.
45+4' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
45+4' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is cautioned by the referee.
45+1' John McGinn (Aston Villa) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
45+1' John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. Aston Villa win a corner.
45+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' The resulting free kick from John McGinn (Aston Villa) ends up in the gloves of the keeper. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
44' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robert Jones blows for a foul.
42' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Manchester Utd was in an offside position.
42' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
39' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
37' Casemiro (Manchester United) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Robert Jones ignores the protests.
36' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
33' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
32' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
30' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
29' A clumsy foul by Matty Cash (Aston Villa) and Robert Jones blows his whistle.
28' Golden chance! Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
27' Andre Onana (Manchester United) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
26' Looks like Andre Onana (Manchester United) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
25' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
24' A cross from a corner kick by Aston Villa is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

24' John McGinn (Aston Villa) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Andre Onana, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Aston Villa earn a corner.
22' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
21' A precise low pass is received by Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
21' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
20' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.
17' 0 - 1 GOAL - 0:1! The corner comes over and Harry Maguire flicks on with his head to Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
17' Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
17' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.
16' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Jones no option but to blow his whistle.
14' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
14' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
13' The corner from Luke Shaw (Manchester United) is intercepted by the defence.
13' Wow, what an escape. Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Manchester Utd get a corner.
12' Manchester Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
12' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Harry Maguire (Manchester United) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.

11' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
10' The corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is cleared away by the defence.
9' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Good work from Manchester Utd as they win a corner.
8' Flag goes up against Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is caught offside!
3' Robert Jones blows his whistle. Matty Cash (Aston Villa) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Robert Jones.
